spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Leanne Thornbury. The app was down yesterday and I couldn’t pay my electricity bill on time. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that happened, Leanne. I can understand why you’re frustrated. Before I discuss your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s verified. I’ll make sure the late payment charge is refunded, so you won’t be left out of pocket.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s good, but I’ve already had a message from the energy company saying the payment was late.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had to deal with that. I’m logging this as a complaint about the app being unavailable and the impact on your bill payment.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I’d like to know what’s going to happen now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of it. I’ll send the complaint to our app support team today and I’ll call you by Friday to update you on what we’ve found.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. Will someone else be in touch as well?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Someone may be in touch as part of looking into it, but I can’t say exactly when. We’ll also write to you about the complaint process.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Fine. I just don’t want to be charged because the app wasn’t working.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and I’m sorry for the trouble this has caused. I’ll make sure the team looks at the charge, and I’ll call you by Friday.
